status_definitions.PLANNED: Named future asset without a completed public-safe artifact.
status_definitions.LOCAL_READY: Complete local public-safe artifact, not publicly deployed.
status_definitions.AWAITING_OWNER: Owner-only action is required before progress.
status_definitions.SUBMITTED: Public placement exists or submission was sent, but complete publication acceptance is not verified.
status_definitions.PUBLISHED_VERIFIED: Exact public URL, ownership, content or function and version were checked.
status_definitions.MEASURED: A documented observation exists; this does not imply causal impact.
status_definitions.BLOCKED: Progress is prevented by a documented external condition.
status_definitions.REJECTED_WITH_REASON: The proposed asset or placement was rejected with a recorded reason.

included: Current public surfaces explicitly branded as SHAR Production or using the SHARProduction namespace.

Individual website pages, case pages and generated files that belong to the canonical website asset.
Local-only drafts and source packages not publicly deployed.
Search-engine appearance, citations, usage or impact without direct evidence.
